name: Haus Alpin
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated on an elevated site in Ellmau, Haus Alpin features bright, comfortable rooms and holiday apartments. Private balconies showcase unobstructed vistas of the Kaiser range.

The Hartkaiser cable car, the KaiserBad Ellmau leisure pools, and SkiWelt slopes are conveniently close.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Alpin in Ellmau charms guests with panoramic Wilder Kaiser views and cosy alpine comfort.
